properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Primary curve of the wallet: SLIP-10 secp256k1 key derivation + ECDSA signing (coincurve/libsecp256k1 default, pure-Python ecdsa fallback via SLIP10_SECP256K1_CONST.USE), backing every Bitcoin-family coin config, the p2pkh/p2sh/p2wpkh/p2wsh/p2tr address encoders (incl. Taproot x-only tweak), BIP32/44/49/86 HDs, and WIF keys. Quantum-unsafe (Shor) signature + key-derivation primitive — the highest-value migration item in this codebase.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Ed25519 signatures in four shipped variants: SLIP10-Ed25519 standard (PyNaCl nacl.signing, eccs/slip10/ed25519/private_key.py:8), SLIP10-Ed25519-BLAKE2b (ed25519-blake2b dependency, Cardano), Kholaw-Ed25519 (Algorand, 64-byte keys, group ops via nacl.bindings crypto_scalarmult_ed25519_* in the vendored hdwallet/libs/ed25519.py), and SLIP10-Ed25519-Monero (CryptoNote, keccak-based spend/view keys). Used for Solana, Stellar, Algorand, Aptos, Sui, Near, MultiversX, Tezos, Nano, Cardano, Monero. Qua

Quantum-unsafe (Shor) signature primitive used for every Bitcoin-style chain in the wallet.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: BLAKE2b-224/256: Cardano Shelley-era address root hashing (addresses/cardano.py:213 blake2b_224(sha3_256(serialize))), Byron-era payload hashing, and the Ed25519-BLAKE2b signature variant where BLAKE2b replaces SHA-512 inside the ed25519-blake2b library. Quantum-safe hash.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Keccak-256 (the pre-standard SHA3 variant EVM chains require — Ethereum/Tron address derivation, EIP-55 checksums via pycryptodome's keccak module), CryptoNote keccak-256 for Monero spend/view key derivation and address checksums, and SHA3-256 for Aptos/ICON/Cardano address roots with a pycryptodome SHA3_256 fallback (crypto.py:448-450). Note Keccak-256 and SHA3-256 are different paddings — the wallet needs both. Quantum-safe hashes.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Wallet seed/master-key KDF, always HMAC-SHA-512 based: BIP39 mnemonic-to-seed and Electrum v2 at the standard 2048 rounds; Cardano Byron/Icarus master-key derivation; the Byron-legacy path-key (hds/cardano.py:443) runs 500 rounds with salt 'address-hashing' over already-derived key material (pubkey+chaincode), per the Cardano SL spec — not a user-password KDF.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHA-256 in its Bitcoin-ecosystem roles: hash160 (RIPEMD-160∘SHA-256) and double-SHA-256 for addresses/checksums, HMAC-SHA-256 keys, RFC-6979 deterministic-nonce derivation. Quantum-safe hash, kept for CBOM completeness; note libs/ecc.py:43 also embeds a RIPEMD-160 (AST-rated D). tests/test_base58.py:55 is a unit-test call, still a real hash operation.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: HMAC-SHA-512 as the KDF for Algorand's Ed25519 HD derivation (Ed25519 key tweaking and hardened/normal child key + chain code derivation, per the Algorand deterministic-wallet spec). Strong, quantum-safe MAC.

Availability-only: the dependency inventory records what the build ships; the primitive is reachable only through dynamic import or third-party extensions.

properties.value: Pure-Python ECDSA (ecdsa package, ecdsa>=0.18.0,<1): the fallback SLIP-10 secp256k1 backend selected by SLIP10_SECP256K1_CONST.USE, and the ONLY backend for the SLIP10-Nist256p1 (NIST P-256) ECC — SigningKey/VerifyingKey over curves.NIST256p in hdwallet/eccs/slip10/nist256p1/.
